text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Zimbabwean government last week chartered a Boeing 737 from the state national airline to fly President Robert Mugabe's wife, Grace, her three children and bodyguards to South Africa, ignoring growing public pressure on the first family to stop "commandeering" and disrupting flight schedules at loss-making Air Zimbabwe.
- Zimbabwe police say they are worried that drugs are increasingly finding their way into the southern African state.

- President Mugabe said on Thursday his ruling ZANU-PF politburo had expanded by three to five, a special political committee spearheading efforts by black businessmen to acquire shares in leading multinationals.
